Your Thanksgiving centerpiece, raised by a local family. 🦃

Thanksgiving is about gathering around the table—and we’d love to be part of yours. Reserve a pasture-raised turkey from Roswell Family Farm, right here in Upstate New York.

🦃 $5/lb, fresh and unfrozen for Thanksgiving
⚖️ Expected to weigh 20+ pounds, with sizes varying by bird
💚 $10 deposit reserves your turkey and comes off your final balance

Pickup: Tuesday, November 24, afternoon and evening, or Wednesday, November 25, throughout the day.

Message Roswell Family Farm to reserve. Deposits can be sent through Venmo to @Emily-Roswell. If you cancel, the deposit is nonrefundable and helps cover processing costs.
